title: How wastewater treatment works
status: Narration wording pending user approval; visual draft uses no paid generation
scope: Generic domestic wastewater STP concept, not a supplier design or an Oceanides-owned facility. Septage intake is explained separately.

sources.use: Visual reference only: model-specific tank cutaway, component focus and animated treatment. No footage, audio, geometry or product claims reused.
Screening, primary clarification, biological treatment and disinfection.
Reference product still requires service and periodic sludge removal. Not specifications for Oceanides.
Domestic wastewater definition and discharge permit context.
Septage is liquid and solids pumped from septic tanks or similar domestic systems.

scenes.title: Wastewater starts here
scenes.caption: Mula sa toilets, sinks at wash areas, may wastewater na lumalabas sa building araw-araw.
scenes.vo: Mula sa toilets, sinks at wash areas, may wastewater na lumalabas sa building araw-araw.

scenes.title: STP or septage facility?
scenes.detail: Building wastewater / Waste pumped from septic tanks
scenes.caption: STP para sa wastewater ng building. Septage facility para sa waste na hinigop mula sa septic tanks.
scenes.vo: Ang STP ay para sa wastewater ng building. Ang septage facility naman, para sa waste na hinigop mula sa septic tanks. Magkaiba ang intake at treatment needs nila.

scenes.title: Inside the treatment process
scenes.caption: Ito ang isang simpleng STP flow. Nag-iiba ang actual setup depende sa site at wastewater.
scenes.vo: Ito ang isang simpleng STP flow. Nag-iiba ang actual setup depende sa site at wastewater.

scenes.title: First, remove large debris
scenes.caption: Sa screening, nahihiwalay ang malalaking debris bago pumasok sa treatment.
scenes.vo: Sa screening, nahihiwalay ang malalaking debris bago pumasok sa treatment.

scenes.title: Let the solids settle
scenes.caption: Sa settling tank, lumulubog ang mas mabibigat na solids. Tuloy ang liquid sa susunod na stage.
scenes.vo: Sa settling tank, lumulubog ang mas mabibigat na solids. Tuloy ang liquid sa susunod na stage.

scenes.title: Treatment with air and biology
scenes.caption: Sa biological treatment, tumutulong ang microorganisms na i-break down ang organic waste. Sa aerobic system, may air supply para suportahan sila.
scenes.vo: Sa biological treatment, tumutulong ang microorganisms na i-break down ang organic waste. Sa aerobic system na ito, may air supply para suportahan sila.

scenes.title: Separate the remaining solids
scenes.caption: Nahihiwalay ang natitirang solids. May sludge na ibinabalik sa process, at may excess na kailangang alisin.
scenes.vo: Pagkatapos, nahihiwalay ang natitirang solids. May sludge na ibinabalik sa process, at may excess na kailangang alisin.

scenes.title: Finish the treatment
scenes.detail: Disinfection and other treatment, as designed
scenes.caption: Kung kailangan sa design, may disinfection o dagdag na treatment bago ang outlet.
scenes.vo: Kung kailangan sa design, may disinfection o dagdag na treatment bago ang outlet.

scenes.title: Test before discharge
scenes.detail: Water quality determines the next step
scenes.caption: Mas malinaw na tubig ay hindi agad drinking water. Testing at applicable requirements ang basehan ng discharge o reuse.
scenes.vo: Mas malinaw na tubig ay hindi agad drinking water. Testing at applicable requirements ang basehan ng discharge o reuse.

scenes.title: Keep treatment working
scenes.detail: Inspection, equipment care and sludge removal
scenes.caption: Kailangan pa rin ng inspection, equipment care at sludge removal. Dito nakasalalay ang tuloy-tuloy na treatment.
scenes.vo: Kailangan pa rin ng inspection, equipment care at sludge removal. Dito nakasalalay ang tuloy-tuloy na treatment.

scenes.title: Better wastewater management
scenes.detail: Lower pollutant load / Managed waste / Planned operation
scenes.caption: Para sa company, nakakatulong ang tamang system sa mas maayos na wastewater management at pagbawas ng pollutants bago ang discharge.
scenes.vo: Para sa company, nakakatulong ang tamang system sa mas maayos na wastewater management at pagbawas ng pollutants bago ang discharge. Sa site assessment nagsisimula ang tamang pagpili.
